description: A non-modal panel anchored to a trigger on desktop that becomes a bottom drawer on mobile.
overview:
`Flyout` shows supplementary content, such as a small form or a share link, next to the control that opened it. On desktop it renders a `Popover` positioned against the trigger. Below the `48rem` breakpoint it renders a bottom `Drawer` with a swipe handle, and each part switches to its drawer counterpart: `FlyoutHeader`, `FlyoutTitle` and `FlyoutDescription` map to the drawer's header, title and description, and `FlyoutBody` gains padding.

Use it for quick settings or filters that do not need a full modal.
usage: The flyout can be controlled with `open` and `onOpenChange` or uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`. `align`, `alignOffset`, `side` and `sideOffset` on `FlyoutContent` position the desktop popover and are ignored on mobile. Put interactive content in `FlyoutBody`, and use `FlyoutClose` for a button that closes the flyout after an action.

examples.WithCloseButton: Adds an icon close button to the mobile drawer with `showCloseButton`.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Adds a text close button labelled Done to the mobile drawer with `closeLabel`.
examples.WithClose: Uses `FlyoutClose` on a Copy link button so the action also closes the flyout.
examples.Floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with `floating`.

parts.Flyout: The root that renders a `Popover` on desktop and a `Drawer` on mobile.
parts.FlyoutTrigger: The button that opens the flyout.
parts.FlyoutContent: The popup; a `PopoverContent` on desktop and a `DrawerContent` on mobile.
parts.FlyoutTitle: The flyout's title, used as its accessible name.
parts.FlyoutDescription: Supporting text, used as the flyout's accessible description.
parts.FlyoutBody: The main content area, padded on mobile.
parts.FlyoutClose: A button that closes the flyout.

Flyout.onOpenChange: Called when the flyout opens or closes.
Flyout.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with fully rounded corners.

FlyoutTrigger.render: Replaces the default button element with your own element, such as a `Button`.

FlyoutContent.showCloseButton: Shows a close button in the mobile drawer.
FlyoutContent.closeLabel: Replaces the drawer's close icon with this text; requires `showCloseButton`.

FlyoutClose.render: Replaces the default button element with your own element, such as a `Button`.

accessibility:
- The popup has the `dialog` role, named by `FlyoutTitle` and described by `FlyoutDescription`.
- Opening moves focus into the flyout.
- `Escape` closes it and returns focus to the trigger; pressing outside also closes it.
notes: Parts carry `data-slot` values from `flyout` through `flyout-close`. `showCloseButton` and `closeLabel` only affect the mobile drawer; on desktop, add a `FlyoutClose` if the popover needs an explicit close control.
